name: Malta

flag.description: Two equal vertical bands, white at the hoist and red, with a representation of the George Cross edged in red in the upper hoist corner.
flag.symbolism: White and red are traditional Maltese colours; the George Cross was awarded to the island by King George VI in 1942 for its bravery during the Second World War.

hook: Malta splits white and red vertically and pins a small grey medal, the George Cross, in the white corner.
trivia: The George Cross was awarded collectively to the people of Malta on 15 April 1942, during a long wartime siege.
Maltese is the only Semitic language that is an official language of the European Union, and it is written in the Latin alphabet.
